Your All-in-One Search Assistant
TrustFinder is your deep search AI assistant for people, images, and product price searches, built to make finding information simple and fast. Search anything instantly and get organized, accurate results. Whether you need to find a person, trace an image, or compare product prices, TrustFinder combines multiple search tools in one app to save you time.

QUICK AND INTELLIGENT SEARCH
TrustFinder works as an AI-powered people search engine, pulling results from multiple publicly available sources at once. Instead of switching between apps or browsers, get a comprehensive view in one place, with the most relevant public results shown first.

FIND PEOPLE BY NAME
Enter a name, and TrustFinder works like a people finder and profile finder, running a deep search across publicly available sources to surface public profiles, posts, and mentions linked to that name. Use username search to check popular platforms at once and see whether a handle matches a real, public profile before you follow or connect - a smart way to reconnect with old contacts or double-check someone new.

WHY USE OUR DEEP SEARCH AI PEOPLE SEARCH? 
- Reconnecting with old friends or lost contacts
- Networking and professional research
- Recruiters verifying public professional backgrounds
- Journalists and researchers gathering public data
- Online safety checks before meeting someone new

REVERSE IMAGE SEARCH
Upload a photo, capture one with your camera, or paste an image URL to run a reverse image search. Trace where else a photo appears online, discover its source, or find visually similar content - fast and accurate.

FIND PRODUCTS AND COMPARE PRICES
TrustFinder's product price comparison tool checks prices across major retailers in seconds, helping you find the best deal and availability without visiting multiple websites - built for convenience and savings. Compare prices and shop smarter every time.

CLEAN AND STRUCTURED RESULTS
Every search returns results in a clean, organized format - links, profiles, images, and products - making TrustFinder fast and easy to use. All data comes from publicly available sources only. There is no private database access, no confidential records, and no hidden data of any kind. TrustFinder is built for reconnecting, researching, and shopping smarter - not for harassment, stalking, or unauthorized monitoring of any individual.
